chars.M: MOHAMED: a poor young Moroccan man in his early twenties wearing a faded grey hoodie with one wide red stripe across the chest, black joggers and worn white sneakers.
chars.L: LALLA: a rich elegant Moroccan widow in her late fifties wearing a cream long coat with gold embroidery, a burgundy silk headscarf, large gold bracelets and big dark sunglasses pushed up on her head, holding a small gold handbag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Agadir street cafe with plastic chairs and glasses of mint tea. MOHAMED sits at a small table wiping tears, embarrassed and surprised, while LALLA stands next to him leaning over and handing him a white paper tissue with a kind, amused smile. Awkward funny moment, other tables empty.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Agadir cafe. MOHAMED in the foreground holds a coffee cup and his phone and looks up, startled. In the middle ground at another table LALLA sits with crossed legs, staring straight at him and smiling charmingly.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe. MOHAMED walks shyly toward LALLA's table carrying his coffee cup, one hand on his chest saying thank you, while LALLA sits and gestures him to sit down, pleased.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe, the two sit together at one small table facing each other. MOHAMED talks with open hands, LALLA listens closely with her chin on her hand, very attentive, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe table. LALLA holds out her luxury phone toward MOHAMED as they exchange phone numbers, MOHAMED types on his old cracked phone with a nervous excited grin.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe table, close medium shot. LALLA speaks confidently and touches MOHAMED's hand on the table; MOHAMED looks at her mesmerized, completely charmed, small hearts of steam rising from the coffee.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe table. LALLA shows MOHAMED an old framed photo of an older man in a suit (her late husband), with a light sad look; MOHAMED leans in, curious and surprised.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A huge sand quarry near Agadir with yellow trucks and excavators, and modern luxury residence buildings behind it. LALLA stands proudly pointing at all of it, while MOHAMED next to her stares with wide eyes and open mouth, amazed by her wealth.
